name: worksyzo
description: Worksyzo - private AI employee for organizations (Knowledge + Memory + Work + Actions)

scripts.docker:reset: docker rm -f worksyzo-postgres worksyzo-redis && docker volume rm worksyzo-pgdata && node scripts/docker-up.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @worksyzo/shared && npm run build -w @worksyzo/db && npm run build -w @worksyzo/storage && npm run build -w @worksyzo/ingest
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently -n shared,db,storage,ingest -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/shared" "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/db" "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/storage" "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/ingest"
scripts.db:reset: npm run docker:reset && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n pkgs,api,web,worker -c gray,green,blue,yellow "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/api" "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/web" "npm run dev -w @worksyzo/worker"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @worksyzo/api
scripts.dev:web:clean: node scripts/free-port.mjs 3001 && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('apps/web/.next',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run dev -w @worksyzo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.setup:neon: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
